project.description: Builds the pic-sure monorepo gateway-rewrite services (gateway, operations-service, hpds-query-service) and ships all three container tarballs. Git hash for this job should be set dynamically by the deployment pipeline, do not add to the global config.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_BRANCH} | cut -d "/" -f 2` GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_COMMIT} | cut -c1-7`
docker run --rm \ -v "/var/jenkins_home/workspace/$JOB_NAME/:/app:z" \ -v maven_m2_cache:/root/.m2 \ -w /app \ --platform=linux/amd64 \ maven:3-amazoncorretto-25 \ sh -lc "mvn -B clean install -DskipTests -T1C"
for svc in gateway operations-service hpds-query-service; do docker build --load \ -t hms-dbmi/pic-sure-${svc}:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT} \ services/pic-sure-${svc}/
docker save hms-dbmi/pic-sure-${svc}:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT} | gzip > pic-sure-${svc}.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp pic-sure-${svc}.tar.gz s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$TARGET_STACK/containers/pic-sure-${svc}.tar.gz done
